screens.why: Price above 50-day and 200-day averages – the trend is up.

screens.name: Near 52-week high
screens.why: Within 3% of the highest price of the past year – strong momentum.

screens.name: Oversold (RSI < 35)
screens.why: Sold off quickly; sometimes bounces, sometimes keeps falling.

screens.name: Overbought (RSI > 70)
screens.why: Ran up fast; risk of a pullback or pause.

screens.name: Unusual volume
screens.why: Traded ≥1.8× normal volume – something is happening.

screens.name: Lower P/E + dividend
screens.why: P/E under 15 and dividend yield over 3% – classic 'value' filter.

screens.name: Downtrend
screens.why: Below 50-day and 200-day averages – the trend is down.

summary.text:
**Big picture**  
Malaysia’s FBM KLCI ended virtually flat (-0.04%), while the US dollar edged up 0.14% against the ringgit to 4.08. US indices fell across the board, led by a 0.92% drop in the Nasdaq as the 10-year Treasury yield climbed above 5.24%.

**Movers**  
- **Gamuda (+0.61%)**: Rose after bagging a RM2.3 billion renewable energy project in Australia.  
- **AMD (+0.22%)**: Extended its strong monthly run after announcing an $8.2 billion deal to acquire AI startup World Labs.  
- **Inari Amertron (-4.14%)**: Dropped steeply on heavy volume amid a wider pullback in broader tech sentiment.

**Worth watching**  
- **Gamuda**: Triggered a golden cross (50-day average crossed above the 200-day) with improving bullish MACD momentum.  
- **Tenaga Nasional & Press Metal**: Both printed a death cross, with their 50-day moving averages sinking below their 200-day averages.

**Concept of the day**  
A **Golden Cross** is a chart pattern where a short-term moving average (like the 50-day) crosses above a long-term average (like the 200-day). Investors often view it as a technical signal that price momentum may be shifting upward over the longer term.
